parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation and obtain the **Id** field value of the target hybrid cloud cluster from the **ClusterInfos** array in the response. If no cluster is available, call the [CreateHybridCloudCluster](~~2980286~~) operation to create a hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the server.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**. For more information about paging, see the PageSize parameter.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates that each page contains 10 entries. For more information about paging, see the PageNumber parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
